fields.summary_ko.0: SpaceX (SPCX) has market capitalization of approximately $2 trillion, with analysis suggesting stock price could reach $375 (approximately 2.5x current price) in three years
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 Starlink connectivity business revenue increased 69% to $5.25 billion from $3.1 billion year-ago, generating $24 billion in operating profit and serving as primary driver of Q3 profitability
fields.summary_ko.2: Q3 Super Intelligence (SI) business segment revenue surged 830% to $7.56 billion year-over-year, becoming SpaceX's fastest-growing business segment since xAI acquisition in February
